Respondent
 Coram : Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Vinod S. Bhardwaj

Present :- Mr. Lovepreet Handa, Advocate for the petitioner
 petitioner.

Dr. (Ms.)
 (Ms.) Savi Nagpal, Aag, Punjab
 Punjab.

The instant petition has been filed under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita,
2023 for grant of anticipatory bail to the petitioner in case bearing FIR No.0046 dated 08.06.2025 registered under Sectionss 406, 420 of the Indian Penal Code, e, 1860 at Police Station Talwandi Chaudharian, District Kapurthala.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner inter alia contends that pursuant to the order dated 15.12.2025 passed by this Court, the petitioner has joined investigation and is no longer required for investigation of the case.
3.
Learned State counsel on instructions, corroborates the said averment and submits that the custodial interrogation of the petitioner is not required for the purpose of investigation.
4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.

5. Since the petitioner has joined the investigation and his custodial interrogation is not required,
the present petition is allowed and the interim order dated 15.12.2025 is made absolute.

6. However, if required, the petitioner(s) shall co continue to join investigation as and when required to do so and shall abide by the terms and conditions, as laid down under Section 482 (2)
BNSS.
 (VINOD S. BHARDWAJ)
